name: return-flowcell-field-anomaly-to-science
verb-phrase: returning a FlowCell field anomaly to Science
description: Use when a reproduced Engineering mismatch needs scientific interpretation after ordinary implementation causes have been checked.
preconditions: exact configuration and expected model/claim resolve
raw traces and calibration state are available
Engineering states which ordinary causes were checked
postconditions: one discriminating scientific question is stated
mismatch size, reproduction, environment, checked causes and consequence are preserved
input-shape: FlowCell scientific/configuration evidence appropriate to the named procedure
output-shape: Typed FlowCell scientific evidence packet described by the postconditions
